**8B.7 Research Note: Vladimir Putin in 2023**

Overall read: **mixed, but mostly yes for regime durability/war mobilization and mostly no for restraint, lawfulness, and civilian welfare**. If the claimed or revealed goals are taken at face value, the strongest outcome alignment is with **military mobilization, coercive control, and regime survival**. Outcomes were much less aligned with the more restraint-oriented, peace-oriented, or broad-welfare claims.

**Accepted Claims**

- **Russia still posted strong headline growth in 2023**
  - Publisher: Rosstat
  - Date: 7 Feb 2024
  - URL: https://www.rosstat.gov.ru/folder/313/document/230009
  - Summary: Rosstat’s first 2023 estimate put GDP growth at 3.6% year over year. This is a real positive outcome for Putin’s resilience narrative, though it is aggregate and does not prove broad-based welfare gains.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.3, 8B.4

- **Official poverty statistics improved modestly in 2023**
  - Publisher: Rosstat
  - Date: 6 Mar 2024
  - URL: https://www.rosstat.gov.ru/folder/313/document/232165
  - Summary: Rosstat said the poverty rate fell from 9.8% to 9.3% in 2023 and attributed part of the decline to targeted social programs, rising real wages, and pensions. This supports a limited welfare-positive reading, with the obvious caveat that aggregate poverty decline does not equal broad life-chance improvement.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.4, 8B.6

- **Putin retained high approval after the Wagner mutiny**
  - Publisher: Levada Center
  - Date: 14 Jul 2023
  - URL: https://www.levada.ru/en/2023/07/14/approval-of-institutions-ratings-of-politicians-and-parties-at-the-end-of-june-2023/
  - Summary: Levada reported limited short-term movement after the mutiny and a July approval reading of 69% approve / 23% disapprove. That is outcome evidence favoring the regime-durability side of Putin’s revealed goals.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.3, 8B.5

- **Defense spending was translated into a much larger budget share**
  - Publisher: Reuters
  - Date: 29 Sep 2023
  - URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-2024-defense-spending-rise-record-share-budget-2023-09-29/
  - Summary: Reuters reported defense would consume roughly a third of the 2024 budget. That is a clear outcome in the direction of Putin’s war mobilization priorities, but it also shows civilian opportunity costs.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.3, 8B.6

- **Inflation and household stress moved in the wrong direction**
  - Publisher: Reuters
  - Date: 8 Dec 2023
  - URL: https://www.investing.com/news/economy/russian-inflation-accelerates-in-november-rate-hike-becks-3252956
  - Summary: Reuters reported inflation accelerating and households having limited savings, with living standards dragged down across the country. This is negative outcome evidence against any claim that 2023 materially improved ordinary people’s welfare.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.3, 8B.4

- **Families were forced to cut back on basic goods**
  - Publisher: Reuters
  - Date: 16 Nov 2023
  - URL: https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/in-wartime-russia-soaring-prices-bite-as-election-looms-3235923
  - Summary: Reuters reported rising prices for baby food, nappies, and other essentials forcing families to cut back. That is direct counterevidence to a broad welfare-first or stability-first outcome story.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.4, 8B.6

- **The Kakhovka disaster produced major civilian harm, not protection**
  - Publisher: ICRC
  - Date: 14 Jun 2023
  - URL: https://www.icrc.org/en/document/russia-ukraine-international-armed-conflict-icrc-continues-to-help-people-in-need
  - Summary: The ICRC said military activity and the dam destruction created additional threats to civilians and essential infrastructure. This is outcome evidence against Putin’s claims of protective or humanitarian control in the war zone.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.1, 8B.3, 8B.5

- **Putin ordered rescue efforts after the dam breach, but only as partial mitigation**
  - Publisher: Reuters via ThePrint
  - Date: 7 Jun 2023
  - URL: https://theprint.in/world/putin-accuses-ukraine-of-destroying-the-kakhovka-dam-at-behest-of-west/1617195/
  - Summary: Putin instructed emergency services to organize aid, which is a real operational response. But the broader outcome still featured large civilian harm, displacement, and blame-shifting rather than a successful protection result.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.3, 8B.6

- **Arms-control and restraint outcomes moved in the wrong direction**
  - Publisher: Reuters
  - Date: 21 Feb 2023
  - URL: https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/russias-putin-issues-new-nuclear-warnings-to-west-over-ukraine-1.1676971364764
  - Summary: Putin suspended Russia’s participation in New START, threatened renewed nuclear testing, and put strategic systems on combat duty. Outcome-wise, this moved sharply opposite any claimed restraint or strategic-stability goal.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 1B.1, 1B.3, 1B.4, 8B.3, 8B.6

- **Belarus nuclear deployment showed escalation, not de-escalation**
  - Publisher: Reuters via ThePrint
  - Date: 25 May 2023
  - URL: https://theprint.in/world/russia-signs-deal-to-deploy-tactical-nuclear-weapons-in-belarus-says-they-stay-under-its-control/1593879/
  - Summary: Russia formalized deployment of tactical nuclear weapons in Belarus and built a storage arrangement there. That is a concrete outcome in the direction of coercive leverage, not the direction of the restraint language Putin also used.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 1B.1, 1B.6, 1B.7, 8B.6

- **Putin openly confirmed the Belarus deployment as a warning**
  - Publisher: Reuters via Investing.com
  - Date: 16 Jun 2023
  - URL: https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-says-russia-positions-nuclear-bombs-in-belarus-as-warning-to-west-3107500
  - Summary: Putin said warheads had been delivered and framed the move as a warning to the West. The observed outcome matches coercive signaling, not the restrained posture implied by his declaratory policy.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 1B.1, 1B.6, 8B.6

- **The Wagner mutiny was contained, but it exposed major command fragility**
  - Publisher: Reuters via Reuters Connect
  - Date: 24 Jun 2023
  - URL: https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/moment-putin-says-wagner-mutiny-is-treason-in-televised-address/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMucom,2023:newsml_VA240124062023RP1
  - Summary: Putin’s punitive response did not prevent the mutiny, but the state did stop short of an immediate mass bloodbath. Outcome-wise, this is mixed: partial crisis containment, but also evidence that the system was less coordinated than the rhetoric suggested.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.3, 8B.5, 8B.6

- **Elections remained tightly controlled, not meaningfully competitive**
  - Publisher: Reuters
  - Date: 9 Sep 2023
  - URL: https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russians-vote-in-tightlycontrolled-regional-elections-first-since-war-began-3169837
  - Summary: Reuters reported blocked opposition candidates, employer pressure, and voting practices critics said helped falsify results. The outcome moved against any claim of democratic resilience or genuine contestability.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.4, 8B.5

- **Election monitoring was suppressed**
  - Publisher: Reuters
  - Date: 18 Aug 2023
  - URL: https://theprint.in/world/russia-arrests-leader-of-election-monitoring-group-three-weeks-before-regional-polls/1720660/
  - Summary: The arrest of Golos co-chair Grigory Melkonyants and raids on monitors’ homes appear aimed at blocking scrutiny. That points to an outcome of shrinking oversight rather than improved governance quality.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.4, 8B.5

- **Antiwar candidacy was cleared away before the 2024 race**
  - Publisher: Reuters
  - Date: 23 Dec 2023
  - URL: https://theprint.in/world/anti-war-challenger-duntsova-barred-from-running-against-russias-putin/1898291/
  - Summary: The election commission rejected a credible anti-war challenger, clearing the field rather than opening it. This is outcome evidence against any genuine trend toward political opening.
  - Question IDs: 8B.7
  - Other directly informed IDs: 8B.4, 8B.5

**Search gap**

The main gap is that “what Putin claimed they sought” was often mixed or contradictory: domestic welfare, regime durability, war success, strategic leverage, and occasional restraint all coexisted. Because of that, the strongest answer is **not** a single overall direction. Outcomes clearly moved toward **war capacity, coercive control, and regime survival**, while only some aggregate socioeconomic indicators moved modestly in the positive direction.
